documents.title: Annual review — notes
documents.content: Meeting held on 18 June 2024 with John and his wife Sarah. Agenda: performance over the last twelve months, changes in circumstances, goals for the coming year. Portfolio returned 9.8% against a benchmark of 8.9%. John received a promotion and a salary increase of about 15%, so monthly contributions can rise from £1,500 to £2,000. The couple still plan to pay for university for both children from 2034 onwards; we agreed to open Junior ISAs and to review education funding separately. Sarah asked about life cover given the larger mortgage; action for the advisor: obtain quotes for a joint term policy. Attitude to risk was reassessed with the questionnaire and remains at level 6 of 7. No change to the retirement target age of 60. Follow-up actions: increase the monthly contribution from July, open two Junior ISAs, request life cover quotes, send an updated cash-flow forecast by the end of July. Next review scheduled for June 2025. Sarah also mentioned that her parents may gift them money towards the house extension next year; we will document the origin of any such gift when it arrives. John confirmed he is comfortable with the current allocation and does not want to hold individual stocks.
